up: Retrieve all activity rows for the compound CHEMBL1173655 (AFATINIB) and all its salts (parent and related salts via molecule_hierarchy). For each qualifying activity record, retrieve the following fields: compound_chembl_id (molecule chembl id), canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Apply the following filters: target CHEMBL203 (Epidermal growth factor receptor) and standard_type IC50. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: WITH hierarchy AS (SELECT parent.molregno, parent.chembl_id AS chembl_id, parent.molregno AS query_molregno FROM molecule_dictionary parent WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655' UNION SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id AS chembl_id, parent.molregno AS query_molregno FROM molecule_dictionary parent JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655'), target_ids AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203') SELECT DISTINCT h.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.activity_comment, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism FROM hierarchy h JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = h.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_ids t ON ass.tid = t.tid JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = h.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.record_id = a.record_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
